prose: Split from b15da5656579 under RULE 1 (orchestrator 2026-11-16, relaying Akien: "the latest entry remains in cairn commons, and everything else broken into... per day? per week? inside of our .cairn/logs folder"). cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py _only_own_dialog excuses a crossing ticket's own gate dialog from working_tree_clean only when the journal's working copy is HEAD plus appended lines that name the ticket's log. After b15d a door write replaces that path's one line: the working copy is HEAD minus the log's old line plus the new one, last. So the excuse never fires and a refused crossing reads as dirt. It must read the change as lines gone and lines added, every one naming the ticket's own log.
